g.text: A consuming project registers WebContext and DrupalContext
for the whole vocabulary, or extends a raw context and mixes
in only the traits it needs. Each trait declares what it
needs from its host with @phpstan-require-extends: RawContext
for the driver, RawMinkContext for a Mink session only.
Step traits never use other step traits. Shared logic lives
in the concern-named helper traits, composed by whichever
step traits and raw contexts need it.
